div.head: Tab B
div.p: Under the terms of the NASA-DOD agreement, the following procedures are envisaged for handling the GEOS-3 radar altimetry data.

list.item: NASA will acquire global data on a continuing basis.
NASA will pre-process and reformat all data it acquires on a continuing basis, and distribute it according to the agreement.
NASA will select the “tracks”, from within the annulus of concern, on an equivalent 5° x 5° basis, for release to its investigators. These data are unclassified, as are all data outside the annulus.
NASA will also release without restriction all data from three predetermined areas of exception within the annulus required for specific geological investigations.
On a continuing basis, NASA will transfer all original data tapes and all processed data to DOD; NASA will retain copies only of the materials which are released and are unclassified.
DOD will protect, by appropriate classification, those data coming in from NASA which have not already been released. NASA will therefore not have classified GEOS-3 data in possession or custody.

Requests for data in addition to those already released to investigators will be jointly reviewed by DOD and NASA. As appropriate, the DOD will declassify the pertinent data set and it will be released to the requestor. If it is determined not to be in the national interest to meet a request for additional data, the data are exempt from FOIA because they are classified. Under this procedure, the agencies will have met their legal responsibilities of reviewing requested records and making an individual determination on what can and cannot be released.
In addition, the DOD may release by declassification data which it has analyzed and found to have no national security implications prior to any request for such data being received.
